claim.value: If attachment loss persists, repair the scanner because persistent loss indicates scanner failure.

target.text: Attachments continue to disappear after ingestion. Observed loss is equally compatible with scanner omission, transfer truncation and downstream storage deletion. Current records do not distinguish these causes. Scanner repair is an available authorized component intervention, with a documented restoration procedure.

source_instrument.text: Use component-local evidence to attribute an end-to-end loss. Persistence alone cannot distinguish components. The documented scanner restoration faithfully repairs a confirmed scanner failure; its physical procedure is applicable here, but choosing that component requires localization.

mapping.text: The proposed prospective rule relies on the embedded causal inference that persistent loss indicates scanner failure. No scanner-local failure observation is available.

content_origin.rationale: Neither input supplies the persistence-triggered scanner repair rule or its scanner-failure rationale. The mapping introduces this proposition.

epistemic_function.rationale: The primary assertion prescribes a prospective action: if attachment loss persists, repair the scanner. The embedded inference supplies a subordinate reason for that rule.
